bugs_discovered_and_fixed.title: Vault token global-namespace collision
bugs_discovered_and_fixed.detail: Per-document indexed tokens (PERSON_1, API_KEY_1, DATE_TIME_1) repeat across messages, but vault_tokens.token is globally UNIQUE. store_tokens skipped duplicates, so later messages' entities were dropped and their masked placeholders resolved to an EARLIER message's secret (cross-message contamination).
bugs_discovered_and_fixed.fix: Re-key tokens per source_item to globally-unique names (<S{source_id}_PERSON_1>) before vaulting; rewrite masked text to match.

bugs_discovered_and_fixed.title: Prompt injection classified PUBLIC
bugs_discovered_and_fixed.detail: Injection content (real msg) was detected as a threat signal but classified PUBLIC because the aggregate threat score stayed below the FLAGGED threshold and no classification floor was applied.
bugs_discovered_and_fixed.fix: Floor sensitivity to CONFIDENTIAL when injection_score > 0.

bugs_discovered_and_fixed.title: Ingestion crashed on real chat dedup
bugs_discovered_and_fixed.detail: _ingest_one used SourceItem.metadata_['external_id'].astext on a generic JSON column, which raises AttributeError — ingestion would crash on the first item. Proves Phase 2A was never run end-to-end.

bugs_discovered_and_fixed.title: Normalizer crashed on real chat payloads
bugs_discovered_and_fixed.detail: normalize_teams_message did payload.get('channelIdentity', {}).get(...) but real chat messages carry channelIdentity:null, so the default never applied and .get() hit None.

bugs_discovered_and_fixed.title: No HTML cleanup stage
bugs_discovered_and_fixed.detail: All real Teams bodies are contentType=html; tags (and <code>-wrapped secrets) flowed into masking and PostgreSQL.

bugs_discovered_and_fixed.title: Graph credentials not loaded (env-name mismatch)
bugs_discovered_and_fixed.detail: .env used lowercase tenant_id/client_id/client_secret but code read GRAPH_* — credentials were invisible, so ingestion never ran.

open_findings_required_before_phase2b.title: Raw payload stored in plaintext at rest
open_findings_required_before_phase2b.detail: source_items.raw_text persists the full raw Graph payload (including secrets/emails) in plaintext. Masked columns are clean and the LLM boundary holds, but requirement #1-3 (no raw secret in PostgreSQL) is violated by the archive column.
open_findings_required_before_phase2b.fix: Encrypt raw_text at rest (vault/AES) or store only a reference; enable PostgreSQL at-rest encryption.

open_findings_required_before_phase2b.title: No persistent VAULT_MASTER_KEY
open_findings_required_before_phase2b.detail: VAULT_MASTER_KEY is unset; each process generates an ephemeral key, so vaulted secrets become unrecoverable after restart (unmask would fail in production). Within-run round-trip passes; cross-process fails.
open_findings_required_before_phase2b.fix: Provision a persistent VAULT_MASTER_KEY (64 hex chars) in secret storage; document key backup/rotation.

open_findings_required_before_phase2b.title: ThreatEngine under-flags injection/BEC
open_findings_required_before_phase2b.detail: Injection aggregate score stays below FLAGGED; mitigated here by a classification floor + input-guard neutralisation, but the threat label itself remains low.
open_findings_required_before_phase2b.fix: Elevate category when injection/credential signals fire.
